c.request: Match the conservation records to their sites by site code, and drop any with no matching site. How much does each site health and safety status (`healtheval`) account for in the conservation data? Treat a missing status as its own group, and give a count and that count's share of the sum. Then take only the statuses with an above-average share, and return one summary row with the average count, the average share, and the average amount by which the share exceeds the average share. Don't round. Each status's count is the number of distinct sites that have conservation records.
c.sql: WITH conservation_joined AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.healtheval, sc.zoneref FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_analysis AS (SELECT healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) AS status_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref)) OVER () AS total_count FROM conservation_joined GROUP BY healtheval), with_shares AS (SELECT healtheval, status_count, total_count, CAST(status_count AS FLOAT) / total_count AS share, AVG(CAST(status_count AS FLOAT) / total_count) OVER () AS avg_share FROM status_analysis), filtered AS (SELECT healtheval, status_count, total_count, share, avg_share, share - avg_share AS excess_share FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT AVG(status_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess_share) AS average_excess FROM filtered

d.request: Count the number of distinct sites per health and safety status (including NULL as a separate group) from conservation records joined to their matching sites, calculate each status's share of the total distinct site count, filter to statuses with above-average share, and return one row with the average count of distinct sites, the average share, and the average amount by which each above-average share exceeds the overall average share.
d.sql:
WITH site_health_join AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sc.zoneref, s.healtheval
  FROM scanconservation sc
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) as site_count
  FROM site_health_join
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(site_count) AS FLOAT) as total_sites,
    CAST(AVG(site_count) AS FLOAT) as avg_count
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.healtheval,
    sc.site_count,
    CAST(sc.site_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_sites as share,
    t.avg_count / t.total_sites as overall_avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    site_count,
    share,
    overall_avg_share,
    share - overall_avg_share as excess
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > overall_avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CAST(site_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_distinct_sites,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg

b.request: For each site health and safety status (treating missing as its own group), count the distinct sites that have conservation records and that status, calculate each count's share of the total distinct sites with conservation records, filter to statuses with above-average share, and return the average count, average share, and average excess share for the filtered statuses.
b.sql:
WITH conservation_sites AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval
  FROM sites s
  INNER JOIN scanconservation sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zoneregistry) AS site_count
  FROM conservation_sites
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
total_sites AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT zoneregistry) AS total_sites
  FROM conservation_sites
),
status_with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.healtheval,
    sc.site_count,
    CAST(sc.site_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_sites AS share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_sites t
),
average_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM status_with_shares
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sws.site_count,
    sws.share,
    sws.share - a.avg_share AS excess_share
  FROM status_with_shares sws
  CROSS JOIN average_stats a
  WHERE sws.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(site_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(excess_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM filtered_statuses
b.raw: For each site health and safety status (treating missing as its own group), count the distinct sites that have conservation records and that status, calculate each count's share of the total distinct sites with conservation records, filter to statuses with above-average share, and return the average count, average share, and average excess share for the filtered statuses.

a.request: Match each conservation record to its site by site code, and drop records with no matching site. Under each site health and safety status (`healtheval`), with a missing status as its own group, count the number of different sites (distinct `zoneref`) that have at least one conservation record, so a site with several records counts only once. Work out each status's share of the sum of those counts. Then take only the statuses whose share is above the average share across all statuses, and return one summary row with the average count, the average share, and the average amount by which the share exceeds the average share. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH conservation_with_site AS (SELECT sc.*, s.healtheval FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), site_counts_by_status AS (SELECT healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) as site_count FROM conservation_with_site GROUP BY healtheval), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(site_count) as total FROM site_counts_by_status), site_counts_with_share AS (SELECT healtheval, site_count, site_count::float / total.total as share FROM site_counts_by_status CROSS JOIN total), average_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM site_counts_with_share), filtered_statuses AS (SELECT site_count, share, (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_value) as overall_avg_share FROM site_counts_with_share WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_value)) SELECT AVG(site_count) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - overall_avg_share) as avg_excess FROM filtered_statuses
